title: Bazzar
description: A highly responsive, multi-vendor E-commerce platform equipped with a granular admin dashboard, integrated analytics, and logistics tracking.
fullDescription: Bazzar is a fully-featured multi-vendor marketplace built from the ground up. It includes a comprehensive admin dashboard with real-time analytics, vendor management system, product inventory tracking, order management, and integrated logistics tracking with live updates. The platform supports multiple payment gateways and provides a seamless shopping experience for customers.

title: Tes Clone
description: A visually immersive web experience replicating the Tesla interface, integrated with 3D web animations using React Three Fiber.
fullDescription: Tes Clone is a pixel-perfect recreation of the Tesla website with immersive 3D vehicle models and smooth animations. Built with React Three Fiber for real-time 3D rendering, the site features interactive car configurators, color customization, and a showroom experience. Every detail from the scroll animations to the vehicle models has been carefully crafted to match the original Tesla experience.

title: MacOS Clone
description: A complex frontend project replicating the native desktop UX/UI elements of macOS inside a web browser.
fullDescription: MacOS Clone recreates the macOS desktop experience in the browser with remarkable fidelity. Features include a functional dock with app launch animations, a menu bar with real-time clock, draggable and resizable windows, a desktop with wallpaper, and working apps including a calculator, terminal, and notes. The project demonstrates deep understanding of UI/UX patterns and advanced CSS/JavaScript techniques.

title: Home Art
description: An end-to-end full-stack e-commerce solution engineered for tracking, ordering, and managing home appliance inventories.
fullDescription: Home Art is a complete e-commerce platform designed for home appliance retailers. It features a product catalog with advanced filtering, shopping cart with real-time price calculations, order management system, user authentication, and an admin panel for inventory management. The platform is optimized for performance with server-side rendering and incremental static regeneration for fast page loads.
